package.name: outdoor_patrol_safety
package.description: Geometric forward-obstacle safety brake for a 2D LiDAR (M3, ADR-013). Gates the forward velocity of /cmd_vel on a LaserScan return inside a forward angular sector; reverse and rotation pass through. Fails safe on a missing or stale scan. Deliberately dumb (no costmap) — stays in front of Nav2 in later milestones.
